source.author: verg
source.text: hinc exaudiri voces et verba vocantis visa viri, nox cum terras obscura teneret; solaque culminibus ferali carmine bubo saepe queri et longas in fletum ducere voces; multaque praeterea vatum praedicta priorum terribili monitu horrificant.
source.text_original: hinc exaudiri voces et verba vocantis / visa viri, nox cum terras obscura teneret; / solaque culminibus ferali carmine bubo / saepe queri et longas in fletum ducere voces; / multaque praeterea vatum praedicta priorum / terribili monitu horrificant.
source.text_english: From here voices and the words of a man calling were thought to be heard, when dark night held the lands; and on the roofs the lone screech-owl was often heard lamenting in a funereal cry and drawing out long calls into weeping; and many other predictions of seers of old, with fearful warning, made men tremble.

reuse.author: lact
reuse.text: differt igitur, donec ueniat temporum finis, quo effundat iram suam in potestate ac uirtute caelesti, sicut uatum praedicta piorum terribili monitu horrificant.
reuse.text_original: differt igitur, donec ueniat temporum finis, quo effundat iram suam in potestate ac uirtute caelesti, sicut uatum praedicta piorum terribili monitu horrificant.
reuse.text_english: Therefore he delays until the end of the times, when he will pour out his wrath with heavenly power and might, as the predictions of the holy prophets, with their terrible warning, strike fear.
